AT0034.title: Risk IP Addresses
AT0034.description:
Risk IPs are addresses judged to have malicious behavioral tendency based on threat intelligence, behavior analysis, or historical attack records. Common sources include botnet C2 nodes, scan-and-brute-force sources, high-frequency credential-stuffing and crawler sources, proxy-pool and second-dial IP exits, phishing sites, and malware callback addresses. When illicit teams rent such IPs to launch automated attacks, credential stuffing, traffic inflation, or risk-control evasion, the addresses enter threat-intelligence risk-IP lists and are tagged as high, medium, or low risk.

Risk-control and security products typically perform real-time blocking or challenge based on risk-IP reputation databases (e.g., Microsoft Defender TI, AbuseIPDB, internal black-IP pools), so illicit actors rely on proxy IPs (AT0034-001) and second-dial IPs (AT0034-002) to rotate exits and evade reputation matching. Risk IPs are commonly used in interface automation attacks (R0001), credential stuffing (R0003), crawler scraping (R0005), and registration risk-control bypass, and are the primary target of IP profiling (A0029-002) and IP reputation blocking (A0016-001).

AT0034-001.title: Proxy IP
AT0034-001.description: A proxy IP is a network proxy technique used to conceal a device's real IP address. The client first connects to the proxy IP, which then forwards the request to the target website, leaving only the proxy IP in the site's access logs. Common proxy IP types include HTTP proxies, HTTPS proxies, and SOCKS proxies.

AT0034-002.title: Second-Dial IP
AT0034-002.description: As a dynamic dial-up implementation of AT0034-001 proxy IPs, a 'second-dial IP' exploits the fact that home broadband connections obtain a new IP address each time they reconnect. Criminals rent large numbers of home broadband lines and rapidly generate millions of IP addresses to form an 'IP pool', which is then provided to cybercrime groups. The resulting massive volume of IP addresses circumvents normal IP-based restrictions, making it extremely difficult for law enforcement to trace criminal activity.
